action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.998, acf1=0.9996) with negligible seasonality (0.085). Model ranking is only moderately stable (Kendall tau 0.54) and errors are highly correlated (mean corr 0.676, only 3 independent groups). In this regime, a trimmed mean over the 9 most consistently-ranked models is the right balance: selective enough to exclude the 11 weaker models (median error 155 vs top-9 median ~120), robust enough to avoid overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows, and the 20% trim guards against any single model's outlier window. The best single model (DWT_catboost, RMSE 106) scores worse on the composite metric, confirming that diversification across the wavelet-based top group adds value beyond any one model's trend fit.

Model ranking is only moderately stable (Kendall tau 0.54) and errors are highly correlated (mean corr 0.676, only 3 independent groups). In this regime, a trimmed mean over the 9 most consistently-ranked models is the right balance: selective enough to exclude the 11 weaker models (median error 155 vs top-9 median ~120), robust enough to avoid overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows, and the 20% trim guards against any single model's outlier window. The best single model (DWT_catboost, RMSE 106) scores worse on the composite metric, confirming that diversification across the wavelet-based top group adds value beyond any one model's trend fit.
